Thanks — I can help with that. A few quick points first, then options for how you’d like to proceed.

What I can explain now (no account access needed)
- How savings APY is built for Gold accounts: base APY + any tier rate (based on balance) + one checking-account APY boost (if you have qualifying linked checking) + one credit-card APY bonus (if you hold a qualifying card) + any relationship bonuses. Some bonuses stack with others but multiple checking boosts or multiple card bonuses do NOT stack — only the single highest boost/bonus of that type applies.
- Interest typically accrues daily and is credited monthly, so the posted monthly credit depends on the daily balance across the month.
- If you tell me the monthly interest amount you received ($450) and your balance (~$96,000), that implies an annualized APY of about 5.625% (450 × 12 = 5,400; 5,400 / 96,000 ≈ 0.05625). I can calculate expected interest for different APYs if you want to compare.

What I can do if you want me to investigate your specific account
- I can review your linked checking accounts, credit cards, and the interest credit posted last month, verify whether the correct APY components were applied, and — if there’s a calculation error — apply an interest correction and open a backend discrepancy report.
- To access your account and perform those checks or apply any credits, I must first verify your identity. Please confirm which two of the following you can provide: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. After verification I will log the verification and then proceed to look up your accounts and interest posting.

Or, if you prefer not to share verification info here
- I can walk you through how to check your account APY components in the Rho-Bank app/website, or explain how to estimate expected monthly interest for any APY you name.
- I can also transfer you to a human agent — tell me if you want that.

How would you like to proceed? If you want me to investigate, please provide two of: date of birth, email, phone number, or address so I can verify and continue.
